services.name: Sailing Charters
services.desc: Come enjoy a Wine and Cheese Sunset sail with us and immerse yourself in a beautiful evening on the water! After a short safety briefing, we’ll head out in to Baltimore Harbor to take in the sights of the city from the best vantage point, the deck of Condor, our 36′ sailboat. As you relax and enjoy the evening, we will provide a glass or two of wine along with some cheese and crackers. As the evening winds down you will enjoy the spectacular colors as the sun sets over Fort McHenry and the city. Our goal is for you to have the most relaxing evening as possible. Therefore, we provide Chardonnay, Cabernet, and a variety cheeses, crackers, and fruits for you to enjoy while we sail. We leave

blurb: SeaAffinity offers sailing charters and lessons focused on developing life skills through an affinity for the sea. They provide youth outreach programs at no cost and also offer sailing and powerboat training for groups and private lessons. Their sailing charters operate Monday through Saturday from Mid-April to Mid-November and can be booked as group or private experiences.
